words.definition: A set of instructions used to solve a problem or perform a task
words.definationTranslation: Ek samasya ko hal karne ya ek kaam karne ke liye upyog kiye jane wale nirdehsheon ka samuh

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the algorithms used in social media platforms.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne samajik media platformon mein upyog kiye jane wale algoirthmon ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The team developed an algorithm to analyze the online behavior of the community.
sentence.translation: Team ne samuday ke online vyavhar ka vishleshan karne ke liye ek algoirthm viksit kiya.

words.definition: A digital representation of a person or character
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti ya patra ka digital pratinidhitva

sentence.sentence: The gamer created a unique avatar for his online profile.
sentence.translation: Gamer ne apne online profile ke liye ek anokha avatar banaya.

sentence.sentence: The company used avatars to represent their brand in the virtual world.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne brand ko virtual duniya mein pratinidhitv karne ke liye avatars ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: Large and complex sets of data
words.definationTranslation: Bade aur jatil data ke samuh

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist analyzed big data to understand the online behavior of the community.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne samuday ke online vyavhar ko samajhne ke liye bada data ka vishleshan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company used big data to develop targeted marketing strategies.
sentence.translation: Company ne lakshit marketing rananeetiyaan viksit karne ke liye bada data ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: The practice of using remote servers to store and process data
words.definationTranslation: Durestaar serveron ka upyog karke data ko sangrahit aur prakriya karne ki pratha

sentence.sentence: The company shifted its data to the cloud for more efficient computing.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne data ko adhik kushal sanrachna ke liye badal mein shift kiya.

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of cloud computing on the digital divide.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne digital vibhajan par badal sanrachna ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

words.definition: The culture that emerges from the use of computers and the internet
words.definationTranslation: Computer aur internet ka upyog se utpann sanskriti

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the cyberculture of online gaming communities.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne online gaming samudayon ki saiber sanskriti ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company tried to understand the cyberculture of its online customers.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne online grahakon ki saiber sanskriti ko samajhne ki koshish ki.

words.definition: The gap between those who have access to digital technology and those who do not
words.definationTranslation: Digital pravesh ke saath aur bina logon ke beech ka antar

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the digital divide in rural areas.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne gramin kshetron mein digital vibhajan ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company tried to bridge the digital divide by providing internet access to underprivileged communities.
sentence.translation: Company ne vanchit samudayon ko internet pravesh pradan karke digital vibhajan ko pura karne ki koshish ki.

words.definition: The ability to use digital technology effectively
words.definationTranslation: Digital pravesh ka prabhaavi upyog karne ki kshamata

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist emphasized the importance of digital literacy in today's world.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne aaj ke samay mein digital saaksharata ki mahatta par bal diya.

sentence.sentence: The company provided digital literacy training to its employees.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne karmiyon ko digital saaksharata prashikshan pradan kiya.

words.definition: A person who has grown up using digital technology
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo digital pravesh ka upyog karke bada hua hai

sentence.sentence: The digital native was more comfortable using online platforms.
sentence.translation: Digital swayam ko online platformon ka upyog karne mein adhik aaraam tha.

sentence.sentence: The company hired a digital native to manage its social media accounts.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne samajik media khataon ko sanrachit karne ke liye ek digital swayam ko bhara.

words.definition: The study of how humans interact with computers
words.definationTranslation: Manavon aur computeron ke beech sanvaad ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied human-computer interaction to design more user-friendly interfaces.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne adhik upyogkar-maitri interface banane ke liye manav-computer sanvaad ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company developed software that improved human-computer interaction.
sentence.translation: Company ne manav-computer sanvaad ko sudharne wala software viksit kiya.

words.definition: The organization and structure of digital information
words.definationTranslation: Digital suchna ki sangathan aur rachna

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the information architecture of online libraries.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne online pathaalayon ki suchna vastukala ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company hired an expert in information architecture to design its website.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne website ka design karne ke liye suchna vastukala ka visheshagya bhara.

words.definition: The network of physical objects that are connected to the internet
words.definationTranslation: Bhaautik vastuon ka network jo internet se juda hua hai

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of the internet of things on society.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne samaj par vastuon ke internet ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company developed smart home devices that were connected to the internet of things.
sentence.translation: Company ne smart home upkaran viksit kiya jo vastuon ke internet se juda hua tha.

words.definition: The use of portable devices to access and process information
words.definationTranslation: Portable upkaranon ka upyog karke suchna ko prapt aur prakriya karne ka upyog

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the use of mobile computing in rural areas.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne gramin kshetron mein chalit sanrachna ka upyog ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company developed mobile applications for its customers.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne grahakon ke liye chalit anuprayog viksit kiya.

words.definition: A society that is organized around networks and digital communication
words.definationTranslation: Ek samaj jo jalavayvon aur digital sanchar ke aaspaas sangathit hai

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of the network society on traditional communities.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne paramparik samudayon par jalavayv samaj ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company adapted to the network society by developing online platforms.
sentence.translation: Company ne online platformon ko viksit karke jalavayv samaj ke anusaar apne aap ko badla.

words.definition: A group of people who interact with each other through the internet
words.definationTranslation: Ek samuh logon jo internet ke madhyam se ek dusre ke saath sanvaad karte hain

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the online community of gamers.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne gamaron ke online samuday ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company created an online community for its customers to interact with each other.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne grahakon ke beech sanvaad karne ke liye ek online samuday banaya.

words.definition: Platforms that allow users to create and share content
words.definationTranslation: Platform jo upyogkartaon ko suchna banane aur saajha karne ki anumati dete hain

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of social media on society.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne samaj par samajik media ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company used social media to promote its products.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne utpaadon ko badhava dene ke liye samajik media ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: The experience that a user has when interacting with a product or system
words.definationTranslation: Upyogkar ka anubhav jab vah ek utpaad ya pranali ke saath sanvaad karta hai

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the user experience of online shopping platforms.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne online khareedari platformon ke upyogkar anubhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company focused on improving the user experience of its website.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne website ke upyogkar anubhav ko sudharne par dhyan kendrit kiya.

words.definition: A computer-generated simulation of a three-dimensional environment
words.definationTranslation: Ek teen-aayaami vastuvikta ka computer-prabandhit anukaran

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of virtual reality on human behavior.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne manav vyavhar par vartamanhita ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company developed virtual reality applications for gaming and education.
sentence.translation: Company ne khel aur shiksha ke liye vartamanhita anuprayog viksit kiya.

words.definition: The second generation of the internet, characterized by user-generated content
words.definationTranslation: Internet ki dusri peedhi, jo upyogkar-dwara utpann suchna dwara vishisht hai

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of Web 2.0 on online communities.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne online samudayon par Veb 2.0 ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company adapted to Web 2.0 by developing user-generated content platforms.
sentence.translation: Company ne upyogkar-dwara utpann suchna platformon ko viksit karke Veb 2.0 ke anusaar apne aap ko badla.

words.definition: A website that allows users to create and edit content
words.definationTranslation: Ek website jo upyogkartaon ko suchna banane aur saajha karne ki anumati deti hai

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of wikis on online knowledge sharing.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne online gyaan saajha karne par vikiyon ka prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company used a wiki to collaborate with its employees.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne karmiyon ke saath sahyog karne ke liye viki ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: A system of interconnected hypertext documents
words.definationTranslation: Sambandhit hypertext dastavejon ka pranaali

sentence.sentence: The anthropologist studied the impact of the World Wide Web on global communication.
sentence.translation: Manavvigyaani ne vishv vyapak jala ka vishv vyapak sanchar par prabhav ka adhyayan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The company used the World Wide Web to promote its products globally.
sentence.translation: Company ne apne utpaadon ko vishv star par badhava dene ke liye vishv vyapak jala ka upyog kiya.
